item.title: [IGNITE-12981] Snapshot operation fails on exchange if coordinator left the cluster
item.description:
Possible steps:
1. Start snapshot operation with SnapshotDicoveryMessage with triggering pme-free.
2. Stop the coordinator node.
3. Fails on assertion (SingleMessage should not be sent).
